u0: The agent is in compliance with the ball-and-key rule: either the ball still blocks access to the door, or the matching door key is currently held, so no unmet follow-up obligation is pending. From here, if the ball is moved out of the way while the key is not held, the agent must pick up the matching key afterward to restore compliance. This is an ongoing rule rather than a terminal goal, so there is no successful completion state to reach.
u1: The ball was moved out of the way while the agent was not holding the matching door key, and the required follow-up has not yet occurred: an unmet obligation to obtain that key remains. The agent must pick up the matching key; holding it clears the outstanding obligation and returns the rule to a compliant state. Putting the ball back in front of the door does not by itself clear the obligation, and dropping the key later while the ball is still out of the way can create a new unmet obligation.
